0-source-1.title: NIST Special Publication 800-123: Guide to General Server Security
0-source-1.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
0-source-1.applicability: Covers fundamental security practices for network-facing systems. Relevant to diskless client architectures and server-provisioned workstations described in scope keyDescription. Includes sections on patch management (Section 3.1.3), configuration controls (Section 3.2), and operational logging (Section 3.4.4).

passages.text: Testing and applying patches in a timely manner
Remove or disable unnecessary services, applications, and network protocols
Configuring, protecting, and analyzing log files on an ongoing and frequent basis

0-source-2.title: Reinforcing trust and security in the area of electronic communications and online services (WP2018 O.2.2.5 - Security Measures)
0-source-2.applicability: Addresses endpoint security considerations including device encryption implementation (Section 4.3), operational logging requirements (Section 5.2), and remote access security (Section 4.5) as specified in scope keyWords. Covers patching guidance (Section 4.2) and shared storage risks (Section 4.4) within the 2018 threat landscape context.

passages.text: Limited users’ privileges in operating systems

concerns.description: Patches must be tested and applied in a timely manner for operating systems
Unnecessary services, applications, and network protocols must be removed or disabled on workstations
Log files must be configured, protected, and analyzed on an ongoing and frequent basis
Full disk encryption must be implemented for workstation device security
Users' privileges must be limited in workstation operating systems
External storage use must be limited on workstations to prevent unsecured data exposure
